submission.justification: No valid design recommendation can be made from the recorded results. The laboratory GWP100 limit (<=150) is a hard requirement, but GWP100 was not specified for any of the three candidate mixtures, no compliant candidates were identified, and no timing scan was run. Therefore the forced option field is a placeholder only and should not be interpreted as an approved mixture; the design must not proceed until candidate GWP100 values are documented and at least one compliant mixture is simulated.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: No fine scan or additional scan points were run (s3_fine_scan_points_run=0, s4_additional_scan_points_run=0); selected_time_resolution_ns=-1.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Candidate IDs were mapped (G1, G2, G3), but recommended_mixture_id=-1; the submitted option is only a schema-forced placeholder.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150, as required by the laboratory's environmental policy. This is a hard requirement.
requirements.evidence: GWP100 was not specified for all candidates (candidate1/2/3_GWP100_not_specified=-1 recorded as unspecified) and compliant_candidate_count=0; selected_GWP100=-1.
No valid gap was selected; recommended_gap_mm=-1 and selected gap submitted as -1 placeholder, outside the allowed 1-3 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended mixture and gas gap.
requirements.evidence: Because no candidate was demonstrated to satisfy the hard GWP100 constraint and no timing optimization was performed, there is no defensible recommended mixture/gap pair; this submission records that failure rather than an approved design.
